title: ISO 4414:2010 — Pneumatic fluid power — General rules and safety requirements for systems and their components
locator: Scope and abstract: general rules and safety requirements for pneumatic fluid power systems and components used on machinery.
notes: Official ISO page states this edition was last reviewed and confirmed in 2021. It does not apply to air compressors and their associated factory air-distribution systems. It is not a model-specific FRL, cylinder or valve manufacturing specification.
